{"id":"f6422e11-7c7d-4ec5-b5f9-9d38efb8d53c","body":"October 29 — beta.22 source integrated, committed and pushed; Mac-only publication in progress.

All current application/recovery/hourly/P0–P7 updates are in [12f1769](https://github.com/kokin-blip/Coqui-Crypto/commit/12f1769258109837aa63d67d107a7dd5770155ec), tag `experimental-v0.1.0-beta.22`. All 226 selected paths / 75 source/test/build paths match the commit. The unrelated deleted review ZIP, local review state and historical account/session evidence remain preserved outside distribution.

Exact integrated patched-dependency checks pass 358 suites / 2,488 tests, root/renderer typecheck, lint, root/desktop builds, native safety/fullscreen/focus, performance with sensitivity control, 18 reserve-sale checks, 11 prospective checks and 37 Activity checks. Zod is pinned narrowly to 4.6.6 after the production audit found GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5; the patched audit reports zero vulnerabilities. Build metadata now accepts only verified generated-manifest derivations; real dirty/untracked source remains detected (two real-Git fixture regressions). The Activity verifier explicitly selects disconnected accounting evidence and requires economic P&L/TWR/drawdown unavailable rather than inferring profit from legacy cash journals.

The capture-only P7 verifier correction is delivered with subsequent verification receipts; it changes no shipped application code. Source/tag identities remain immutable. [Release workflow](https://github.com/kokin-blip/Coqui-Crypto/actions/runs/40977922624) is running against the tag, with only Mac arm64 installers selected. [Exact-tag CI](https://github.com/kokin-blip/Coqui-Crypto/actions/runs/40977922538) and branch CI are in progress. Publication/downloaded artifact checks remain pending, not claimed from local tests. Ad-hoc signing/notarization limitations and actual-market latency are explicitly documented.

P5-H, actual P6-G admission, remaining account-wide financial/dispatch/host/credential/connected enforcement and verification, P7-H–J actual owner/reviewer/future/elapsed/final/qualification, human/accessibility/account/review and release acceptance gates remain open in full. No actual profile migration/install, provider activation, credential or host change, order/cancel/withdrawal, Resume, registration/collector/final or qualification occurred. Keep existing issue states, assignees, dependencies and milestone gates.

**Prompt used**

Ok release a new release with all these new updates. mac build only.

Annotation follow-up on the recovery fixes:

> commit those

Final scope clarification:

> No comit those and add all the new changes in the new release.
